Reading the patch, the spec, and all affected files before writing anything. Good. Now reading all the files I'll modify: Now reading the remaining files I'll replace or extend: Now reading CommitFlow, GaslessCommitFlow, and the remaining files: Good. Now reading utils.ts, useDealHistory.ts to understand what needs updating: Good. I have a complete picture. Now I understand exactly what needs to change. Setting up todos: Applying the patch to `src/config.ts` and the next-tier fix to `src/swarm/hooks.ts` simultaneously with other independent updates: Now add `SwarmPass` to config.ts and update hooks.ts next-tier fix, abis.ts, utils.ts simultaneously: Now rewrite `abis.ts` with full v2 ABIs: Now rewrite `hooks.ts` with v2 types, new hooks, and the patch's next-tier fix: Now update `utils.ts` with v2 unit-based price computation and strand check: Now update `useDealHistory.ts` with v2 event signatures (topic hashes for new Committed/Withdrawn signatures): Now rewrite `DealRoom.tsx` with all v2 changes: Now rewrite `CommitFlow.tsx` with v2 quantity picker: Now update `GaslessCommitFlow.tsx` for v2 (units param, authorizationNonce with units, total-based signing): Four issues: `GaslessCommitFlow` (`clearingPrice` unused, set-state-in-effect), `SupplierView` (`computeClearingPrice` renamed to `computePriceAt`, wrong types), `TierProgress` (`minBuyers` → `minUnits`). Let me fix all: Fix the `set-state-in-effect` in GaslessCommitFlow — derive `clampedUnits` during render instead of clamping via effect: Also do the same in CommitFlow.tsx: Now fix `TierProgress.tsx` — it still uses `minBuyers` which is now `minUnits`: Now fix `SupplierView.tsx` — it imports `computeClearingPrice` which is now `computePriceAt`: This is the v1 `SupplierView` — it calls `postDeal` with v1 args and uses `computeClearingPrice`. The contract errors show it also passes `[tierArgs, minNum, deadline, capNum]` which is a v1 signature. This whole component needs updating for v2. Let me read the rest first, then rewrite it: The supplier view needs a complete v2 rewrite. It's scheduled as a future turn. For now I need to fix the two immediate type errors (the import and the wrong call to `computeClearingPrice`/`parsedTiers` shape), which require minimal surgery to make it compile without breaking the visible UI: Now fix `parsedTiers` to use `minUnits` and `computePriceAt` call: Now fix the chart SVG `t.minBuyers` references and the tier-arg shape in `handlePost`: Now fix `handlePost` — the v1 args `[tierArgs, minNum, deadline, capNum]` won't compile with the v2 ABI. For now stub the call to the v2 PostParams struct (the supplier view rewrite comes next turn but the type error is in `SupplierView.tsx`): Now remove the unused `MAX_CAP` import from `SupplierView` if it's still used, and check if the `useChainNow` import from `hooks` is used (it is). Run check again: Zero errors, one warning (unused `useEffect` import). Fix it: Zero warnings, zero errors. Check the dev server is still up: All clean. Here's what changed:

**`src/config.ts`** — active chain listed first so ConnectKit auto-switches to the right network on connect.

**`src/swarm/config.ts`** — `SwarmPass` address field added (zero for now) to both network entries.

**`src/swarm/abis.ts`** — full v2 ABIs for all four contracts: `DealFactory` (v2 `DealPosted` event with `goodsToken`, `PostParams` struct), `DemandPool` (v2 `Committed`/`Withdrawn` with units fields, new reads `totalUnits`/`unitsOf`/`paidPerUnit`/`escrowed`/`authorizationNonce` with units), `Settler` (`goodsClaimable`, `claimGoods`), `SwarmPass`, and generic `ERC20_ABI`.

**`src/swarm/hooks.ts`** — `DealTier` uses `minUnits`; `DealData` has all v2 fields; new hooks `useTotalUnits`, `useUnitsOf`, `usePaidPerUnit`, `useEscrowed`, `useTierCounts`, `useGoodsClaimable`, `useGoodsTokenMeta`; `useLiveDealState` counts units for tier progress and the next-tier hint skips tiers not cheaper than the live price.

**`src/swarm/utils.ts`** — `computePriceAt` (replaces `computeClearingPrice`, counts units not buyers); `computeOrderTotal` returns `paidPerUnit`, `total`, and whether the order breaks a tier; `checkWouldStrandBuyer` updated for units-based logic.

**`src/swarm/useDealHistory.ts`** — topic hashes for v2 event signatures; entries carry `units` and `paidPerUnit`.

**`src/swarm/TierProgress.tsx`** — `minBuyers` → `minUnits` in tier chip rendering.

**`src/swarm/DealRoom.tsx`** — title, description, goods token info ("1 unit = N SYMBOL"), units-sold stat alongside buyer count, both USDC and goods claims in `SettleOrRefundPanel` and `ClaimPanel`.

**`src/swarm/CommitFlow.tsx`** — quantity picker (Minus/Plus, clamped to stock and per-buyer limit), `computeOrderTotal` for total display, tier-break message, approve amount = `maxPPU × units`, `commit(dealId, units)` call.

**`src/swarm/GaslessCommitFlow.tsx`** — quantity picker, signs for `priceAt(totalUnits + units) × units`, `authorizationNonce(dealId, buyer, units, salt)` includes units in nonce, POST body sends `units`, 409 shows new total.

**`src/swarm/SupplierView.tsx`** — minimal compile fix (uses `computePriceAt`, tier shape uses `minUnits`); full v2 supplier form (goods token, tokensPerUnit, title, description) comes next turn.
